resolved_owner_rulings.subject: total_touchdown_credits
resolved_owner_rulings.ruling: Adopt fantasy touchdown credits. total_touchdown_credits = passing_td + rushing_td + receiving_td. A touchdown pass from a starting QB to a starting receiver on the same fantasy team counts as two credits, one passing and one receiving. Intentional. The canonical concept is renamed from total_touchdowns to total_touchdown_credits. Aliases are preserved only for catalog migration. This must not be described as a count of unique NFL scoring plays.
resolved_owner_rulings.catalog_migration_required: Catalog operands 'total_touchdowns', 'touchdowns' and 'offensive_td' resolve to canonical total_touchdown_credits in Rev1.3.

Owner ruling Q-VOCAB-1, 2026-08-01: ADOPTED as FANTASY TOUCHDOWN CREDITS. A touchdown pass from a starting quarterback to a starting receiver on the same fantasy team counts as TWO credits - one passing touchdown credit and one receiving touchdown credit. This double-credit behavior is INTENTIONAL and governed. This quantity is NOT a count of unique NFL scoring plays and must never be described as one. Renamed from total_touchdowns; that name is retained as a catalog-migration alias only.

Yahoo exposes no single made-field-goal counter. The total is the sum of the five documented bracket counters (19-23). The derivation yields a COUNT only; it does not yield distance. GRAMMAR CONSTRAINT: five inputs exceed the closed evaluator grammar's three-operand operand_list limit, so this derivation MUST be normalized upstream and supplied as a single canonical operand. It is NOT presently executable as a catalog expression.
